name: 07508 · North Haledon, NJ
findings: ZIP 07508 (North Haledon) has 75 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07508 (North Haledon) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 07508 (North Haledon) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 20% of all organizations here have no identified type.
